anti_patterns: Never expose internal record IDs, entity types, field or decision keys, code-call names, repository filenames, phase bookkeeping, or agent instructions on a public page.

Do not paste research analysis, source citations, or implementation-review notes into public prose. Keep detailed evidence in linked source artifacts and translate it into a short reader-facing proof statement.
Do not turn the provenance rail into developer marginalia. Every visible label must be understandable to a cold external reader without product-internal vocabulary.
Do not spread the correction color as a general accent; reserve it for a superseded value or correction event.
Do not rely on animation to communicate source, version, correction, disagreement, or refresh; reduced-motion and static views must remain complete.
Do not diverge shared structural tokens from Ateles without a product reason; the products remain siblings through spacing, restraint, and hierarchy.
Do not reuse the Neotoma app or Inspector palette. Public product pages keep their distinct paper, ink, teal, and correction system.

positioning_principles: Neotoma’s visual grammar is a persistent graph: typed records and durable relationships remain connected to sources, prior versions, and the agents that create, retrieve, and update them. Correction is one behavior in that graph, not the whole identity.

Graph and record flows make provenance, version history, relationships, disagreement, and current state understandable before supporting copy. Technical diagrams belong as supporting or reduced-motion media rather than displacing strong cinematic storytelling.

Public provenance rail: use plain labels such as “Source”, “Recorded”, “Version”, “Corrected”, and “Reviewed”. The rail may link to deeper evidence, but it never displays internal record IDs, schema names, field keys, code-call names, repo filenames, or unexplained system vocabulary.

Visible correction: show a concise prior value beside its current replacement, with the superseded value struck through and the current value clearly identified. The story is change with continuity, not a database operation.
Disagreement remains visible: two sourced claims can coexist until review settles the current view. Present who or what disagrees and the current status in ordinary language.
Typography supports the record metaphor: editorial headings carry permanence; monospace is reserved for short public labels such as dates, versions, and statuses—not implementation notation.
Motion may trace a record from source to current state or pulse when a refresh arrives, but the static diagram must retain the full meaning under reduced-motion preferences.

Hero cinema is the preferred primary medium. The current silent 8-second correction-propagation film is a provisional full-field takeover because its cinematic execution is stronger than the code-native diagram; it must be replaced by a graph-first film showing persistent records and relationships, provenance, version history, and multiple agents creating, retrieving, and updating. The graph diagram remains the poster and reduced-motion fallback. No generated text, UI, faces, or generic AI/database imagery.
identity.scope: Neotoma product pages only, distinct from the shared structural design system. The identity is the living record: truth remains understandable as sources arrive, corrections supersede earlier values, disagreement is retained, and freshness changes over time. Public visuals use recognizable source, version, correction, current-state, disagreement, and refresh concepts. Deep provenance stays in linked source and repository artifacts; landing-page surfaces never display internal record IDs, schema names, field names, code-call names, decision keys, or unexplained system vocabulary. Neotoma remains a sibling, not a twin, of Ateles: shared spacing and restraint, different symbolic grammar.

Deliberate: the brief instructs shared structural skeleton with per-product accent/type/signature divergence, not full structural fork — diverging the skeleton too would produce two unrelated products rather than siblings.

color_palette.rationale: Paper/ink metaphor (not a generic accent-on-white SaaS scheme): a record's oldest technology is the page. Teal retained as seed hue from the current live palette (evolutionary, not a rebrand) but restructured. 'correction' is a NEW semantic color role, reserved exclusively for showing a superseded value struck through beside its replacement (signature move 4) — never reused as a UI accent, so it stays unambiguous.

type_scale.google_fonts_licence: All three (Fraunces, Inter, JetBrains Mono) are free, open-license Google Fonts already loaded via the current font mechanism; no licensing action is needed.
type_scale.rationale: Family kept deliberately: research checked 2026-09-21 (fontsinuse.com/typefaces/171187/jetbrains-mono and designmd.app/library/fraunces-typography) supports Fraunces as a warm editorial face and JetBrains Mono as a credible technical companion. Their public roles are distinct: Fraunces gives durable statements a sense of permanence; JetBrains Mono carries short, plain-language record labels such as source, date, version, correction, and status. It must not display internal IDs, schema names, field keys, mechanism calls, or repo filenames.
